items.item_text: A high school diploma or equivalent (e.g., GED or HiSET).

As a Hospital Laboratory Technician II of the Microbiology Lab, you will play a vital role in performing pre- and post-analytical activities to ensure the smooth operation of the clinical laboratory. Your primary duties include:
Perform specimen processing duties, including accessioning, troubleshooting specimen/test order problems, rotating and discarding specimen holds, and filing.
Operate and maintain laboratory equipment to ensure accuracy and reliability of test results.
Monitor inventories of media and reagents used in diagnostic testing to ensure adequate supplies for laboratory operations.
Provide support for quality control and quality assurance activities to maintain the highest standards of laboratory practice.
Perform computer operations (e.g., report printing) and data entry and retrieval to facilitate documentation and reporting processes.
Participate in special studies as required by the laboratory and medical staff to support ongoing research and diagnostic initiatives.
Assist with clinical resource leadership/training in specimen processing to ensure compliance with laboratory protocols and standards.
Proficiency in computer skills, including typing and internet navigation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
Excellent organizational, teamwork, and time-management skills.
Ability to work weekends, holidays, and other shifts as needed to ensure continuous laboratory operations and meet the demands of patient care.
Working knowledge of Microbiology terminology used in a clinical laboratory setting is a plus.
